notes.title: Optimization News v0.1.3j
notes.content: [p]So to be approved for the Steam Deck I have to make sure the framerate doesn't go below 30 fps. But on my i3/GTX 1050 each grenade explosion with 3 victims would dip to 7 fps in "Animals" and 4 fps in "Framerate Killer". Eventually, after many changes and after warmup, the framerate would usually only dip to 70 fps in "Animals".[/p][p]As far as warmups go, Unity's Mono JIT code runs slower the first time it's executed. So the grenades blowing lifeforms into bits is slower on the first run. But warmups involve it being run in advance - like having a grenade blowing up lifeforms off camera so that it runs better the first time the player tries it.[/p][p]I learnt about warmups from a GPT-5 AI that I was getting coding advice from. It also suggested code optimizations for things like slicing, blood effects, and background sound loading so that the framerate drops would be dramatically improved.[/p][p]In other news, you can now hide behind walls to survive grenade explosions, though it still shakes your view.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003474/3ca1af4d9ccb09938607eeeaf35ff8b578f5b40f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: City Invasion achievement v0.1.2o

In a new level you have to build a ladder to get over the city walls like in the Bible passage. To get the achievement you've got to get the city gates open and order the soldiers to cleanse the city. To create the city I took a retro approach and used 2D images for the buildings.

You can now also change the magic laser sword colors in Bonus Options.

notes.title: Holy Hand Grenades v0.1.2n
notes.content: In most Worms games there are Holy Hand Grenades where the Hallelujah Chorus plays. These grenades have been added to the inventory screen in BBB or you can press "4". When the explosions have victims it goes in slow motion though the explosions can also kill you. To improve the framerate the explosions can only kill the 3 closest lifeforms even if it is very crowded.

notes.title: Rounded ears and noses, buildable ladders v0.1.2m
notes.content:
To look even more different to voxel-based games, the people now have rounded ears and noses.

I've also added buildable ladders. The NIRV Bible quote for Deuteronomy 20:20 originally talked about building "war machines" with wood to help capture the city. The CEV is clearer and says "ladders and towers". The TLB also mentions "battering rams".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003474/14855415c1dcd704b5c4958b8b031d5564ec621b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Blood splatter customization v0.1.2L
notes.content: Now in the Bonus Options you can choose between these blood splatter settings: "Bloodbaths" (the style from a few months ago - now the default), "Realistic" (the recent style), and "Ketchup" (a very plain color). The Bonus Options also allow you to change the blood and skin colors to any color in the rainbow. There is also a new item in the inventory, "Wood Collector" - which will be expanded on in the next update.

notes.title: Woolly sheep, the Body Hacker v0.1.2k
notes.content:
Woolly sheep have been added. There is also a new weapon called the Body Hacker. It "hacks" body parts through the matrix in the game. It also "hacks" them by chopping them into quarters. It can be accessed in the inventory by pressing "I". To use it hold down the mouse button while selecting a body part. You can use it to complete the mystery box and hiding behind houses tasks. You can even use it to chop people while they are looking at you through a house window. Also the mystery box now recognizes if you chop every living thing incorrectly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003474/064002422136775d8d26725291ab3409af229e7f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Rideable horses v0.1.2j
notes.content:
Rideable horses have been added. While riding them your sword is much longer and you can chop things as you ride past them. Be careful not to chop your horse while you're swinging your sword around. Though eventually you need to chop it in order to fully cleanse the level. The horse slows down while your sword is turned to the side. I had to do this because sometimes the chops wouldn't register when you're moving too fast. Note you can have problems chopping if you don't wait until your sword is fully extended.

notes.title: Edgy effects and test trees v0.1.2b
notes.content:
In the past people didn't like post processing effects like chromatic aberration, grain, and vignette but now I've made them an option currently known as "edgy effects". By default this also includes blurriness in the distance and color grading where everything is either red or shades of gray. Note that if you already had an earlier version of the game it will begin with chromatic aberration, grain, and vignette disabled inside the edgy effects. You can use Shift-R to reset all of the settings to the defaults and quit. Note that if you choose to go into the edgy effects menu it will always automatically enable it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MCTlzjf.jpeg[/img]
Also the temple test level now includes some new choppable test trees (cone, sphere and capsule). You can press "B" to spray blood on them and push them around. I tried making palm trees but it didn't work very well with chopping because it wasn't a convex shape. These trees aren't fruit trees so God doesn't mind if you chop them (see [url=https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=deuteronomy+20%3A19-20&version=NIRV]Deuteronomy 20:19-20[/url])

In other news boobs no longer fall off when you chop them.

notes.title: Painless and Merciless Cleansing v0.1.2
notes.content: Two new achievements have been added. Painless cleansing means chopping every person and animals heads early so that they don't feel pain. Merciless cleansing means not ending their pain early. The soldiers always kill without mercy so to get that achievement you've got to do the cleansing by yourself.

notes.title: Collision sound effects and stair tweaks v0.1k
notes.content:
There are now sound effects for every chop of your sword including with people, animals, wood, and soliders. There are also collision sound effects when things tumble after being chopped or pushed by the player. If bodies are hit from other things they don't make a sound otherwise there would be too many collision sound effects.

The physics of the stairs have been replaced with steps that bodies can tumble down rather than acting like a ramp.

notes.title: Now the victims scream in agony v0.1j
notes.content:
My first negative review said that "the game fails to demonstrate the real suffering that took place in Philistia and Phoenicia". So they wanted the people to sound like they're in agony rather than the current relaxed groans and gasps.

The Scratch prototype did have lots of screaming as you can see in this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0BDo_eRQFs

So I've made all the humans scream in agony. Note that when it is choosing a random scream it makes sure it doesn't repeat any until it has played all of the rest first.

So in the end I'm glad that guy complained about the lack of suffering... I was actually planning on making them sound even less in agony such as them saying things like "oh no I died!".

notes.title: Game is becoming free
notes.content: As soon as Steam will approve the change the price of the game will change to free. This could take at least two weeks. Existing customers will probably not get a refund of the $0.99 they paid. I am making the game free because I think it is the best way to attract more players and that is what is most important to me.
